subject: test_core_engine_gaps.py O1 cancel assertion: presence -> ordering (reserve before any wait, cancel last)
base_commit_note: e312a12 is the commit the independent review FAILed on. The assertion is applied on top of e312a12 so the review finding is fixed rather than lost.
why: The reviewed assertion tested presence only ("_reserve_exchange_order_slot(" in cancel_body) and therefore passed a reservation-after-sleep regression. The replacement compares byte offsets inside _cancel_order: reserve < sleep < cancel. The single exchange.cancel() count assertion is retained unchanged; the new check is added (24 checks, was 23) and nothing else in the suite is weakened.
assertion_diff:
diff --git a/_archive/hl_stage2/test_core_engine_gaps.py b/_archive/hl_stage2/test_core_engine_gaps.py
index 69f02da..bae0447 100644
--- a/_archive/hl_stage2/test_core_engine_gaps.py
+++ b/_archive/hl_stage2/test_core_engine_gaps.py
@@ -81,6 +81,22 @@ def main() -> None:
     cancel_body = src.split("def _cancel_order(", 1)[1].split("\n    def ", 1)[0]
     check("O1_EXACTLY_ONE_EXCHANGE_CANCEL_CALL", len(re.findall(r"exchange\.cancel\(", src)) == 1
           and "exchange.cancel(" in cancel_body and "_reserve_exchange_order_slot(" in cancel_body)
+    # ORDERING, not presence: a cancel may not WAIT for its slot before reserving it. Reserve first, then
+    # (only if the slot makes us wait) sleep, then the ONE physical cancel last. Presence alone passed a
+    # reservation-after-sleep regression - the exact bug this invariant exists to prevent.
+    i_res = cancel_body.find("_reserve_exchange_order_slot(")
+    i_can = cancel_body.find("exchange.cancel(")
+    i_slp = cancel_body.find("time.sleep(")
+    if i_res < 0 or i_can < 0:
+        ord_ok, ord_br = False, "MISSING_CALL"
+    elif i_slp < 0:
+        ord_ok, ord_br = i_res < i_can, "NO_WAIT_FAST_PATH"
+    else:
+        ord_ok, ord_br = i_res < i_slp < i_can, "WAIT_THEN_CANCEL"
+    print("ORDERING::%s reserve_at=%d sleep_at=%d cancel_at=%d" % (ord_br, i_res, i_slp, i_can))
+    check("O1_CANCEL_RESERVES_SLOT_BEFORE_ANY_WAIT_AND_CANCELS_LAST", ord_ok,
+          "%s not ordered reserve<sleep<cancel: reserve_at=%d sleep_at=%d cancel_at=%d"
+          % (ord_br, i_res, i_slp, i_can))
 
     class FakeExchange:
         def __init__(self):

assertion_summary.WAIT_THEN_CANCEL: time.sleep( present -> assert reserve_at < sleep_at < cancel_at
assertion_summary.NO_WAIT_FAST_PATH: time.sleep( absent -> assert reserve_at < cancel_at only; branch named on the ORDERING:: line
assertion_summary.MISSING_CALL: no reserve or no cancel in the body -> explicit FAIL, never a silent skip
assertion_summary.retained: O1_EXACTLY_ONE_EXCHANGE_CANCEL_CALL (single exchange.cancel() in the whole source, unchanged)
assertion_summary.observability: every run prints ORDERING::<branch> reserve_at=.. sleep_at=.. cancel_at=.. so the branch taken is in the raw log
